info.title: Markora API
info.description: Runtime contract for the Markora V1 API.

200.description: Reachable active folder tree with recursive counts.

422.description: Cycle, depth, or naming policy violation.

404.description: Trashed folder absent from this workspace.

201.description: Folder subtree hidden from active navigation.

409.description: Restore target or Keep Both resolution required.

422.description: Document name is unsafe or lacks .md.

200.description: Document content and stable-ID navigation metadata.
Document renamed or moved without changing content revision.

404.description: Trashed document absent from this workspace.

409.description: Restore target or Keep Both resolution required.

200.description: Immutable version content for preview and diff.

404.description: Document version absent from this workspace.

201.description: Version restored after snapshotting current state.

409.description: Current revision changed or historical name conflicts.

200.description: Revision-guarded Markdown save acknowledged by the server.

409.description: Base revision is stale; server content is unchanged.

413.description: Markdown exceeds the configured size limit.

200.description: Logical Trash roots with recovery metadata.

404.description: Job absent from this workspace or owner.

200.description: Authenticated with an opaque HttpOnly cookie session.
Password changed and other sessions revoked.
Safe summaries of the user's sessions.

404.description: Session is absent or belongs to another user.

200.description: All sessions except the current session revoked.
